scene.summary: The slice closes on reflection, not on a pulse. Score the six dimensions; there is no single perfect path.

dialogue.speaker: Facilitator
dialogue.line: What stayed a question? What stayed protected? Who was never asked to become clinical staff?

captions: Debrief opens. Survival was never the victory condition.

clinicalTruth.airway: Educational boundary: no procedure trainer claims.
clinicalTruth.breathing: Equipment reasoning belongs in debrief, not in invented settings.
clinicalTruth.circulation: Provisional and confirmed phases are available for discussion.
clinicalTruth.communicationAccess: Access, WAIT, and paid-support boundaries are primary reflection themes.

visibleEvidence.label: Six scoring dimensions
visibleEvidence.detail: Clinical reasoning, timing, equipment, communication access, authority/dignity, system sustainability.

visibleEvidence.label: No single perfect path
visibleEvidence.detail: Partial G1, interrupt timing, and restore quality all matter.

communicationBeat.note: Debrief is facilitated reflection; Rohan's access remains respected if he is present.

familyBeat.note: Debrief may name Save Our Sons paid-support sustainability without turning family into clinical labour.

exitConditions.description: Code Blue content pack ends at the debrief hook. UI route arrives in Phase 4.
